baslik: Why did women put poison in their eyes? 👁️☠️ #shorts
aciklama:
Renaissance women used belladonna, deadly nightshade, to enlarge their pupils. Its name means both "beautiful lady" and death.

What do you think? Tell me in the comments 👇

Sources: Linnaeus, Species Plantarum (1753); Garden Professors; WHO Model List of Essential Medicines.
